blocks.text: Their du'aa is lifted above the clouds where the doors of the heavens are opened for it and Allaah says, 'I swear by My honour that I shall definitely assist you even though it may be after some time."[^1]
The Incident of Hadhrat Faatima (RA) when she Went to her Father ﷺ for something of benefit in this World and Returned with Something of Benefit in the Aakhirah

Hadhrat Suwayd bin Ghafalah (RA) narrates that when Hadhrat Ali (RA) was suffering extreme hunger one day, he suggested to (his wife) Hadhrat Faatima (RA) to approach (her father) Rasulullaah ﷺ for some food. When she went to Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA) happened to be there. Hearing Hadhrat Faatima (RA) knocked on the door, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "That is the knock of Faatima. She has come at a time that we are not accustomed to having her come to us." "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Faatima (RA) said, "The food of the angels is to recite 'Laa Ilaaha Illallaah', 'Subhaanallaah' and 'Al Hamdu Lillaah'. What is our food?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "I swear by the Being Who has sent me with the truth! For the last thirty days, no fire (to cook) has been lit in the house of the family of Muhammad ﷺ. However, a few goats have come to us. If you please, I shall have five given to you. Alternatively, if you so please, I shall teach you five words (of supplication) that Jibra'eel (AS) has taught me." Hadhrat Faatima (RA) immediately said, "Do rather teach me the five words that Jibra'eel (AS) has taught you." Rasulullaah ﷺ then told her to say the following words:
blocks.arabic_text: يَا أَوَّلَ الْأَوَّلِيْنَ وَيَا آخِرَ الْآخِرِيْنَ وَيَا ذَا الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِيْنَ وَيَا رَاحِمَ الْمَسَاكِيْنَ وَيَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ

blocks.text: Hadhrat Faatima (RA) then left and when she came back to Hadhrat Ali (RA), he asked, "What happened?" She replied, "While I left you to get something of benefit in this world, I returned with something of benefit in the Aakhirah." "This is the best of all your days," Hadhrat Ali (RA) remarked.[^2]
The Statement of Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) Concerning the Reason for People being Oblivious of the Aakhirah

Hadhrat Anas bin Maalik (RA) reports that they were on a journey with Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) when he heard people talking and having eloquent discussions. "O Anas," he said, "what benefit is there for me in that. Come, let us engage in the Dhikr of our Rabb because it seems like those people can even skin a person with their tongues."
